title: Inheritance and Cipher
author: Theo Zhou
blurb: Ines Blackwood, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the trial begins.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
